description: Run a saved prompt template by id with its template variables in input_values. Generates an AI result, spends the applicable AI credits, and saves the prompt run. Template ids come from aidelly_list_prompts. Returns the generated result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

input_values.description: Key-value pairs for prompt template variables

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_run_prompt
title: Run Prompt
